summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests IDP-023, an NK cell therapy, alone or combined with rituximab, daratumumab, isatuximab, or interleukin-2, in adults with advanced blood cancers, including relapsed or refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma. The record does not state how IDP-023 is given, how often, or for how long, but it describes single-dose and multiple-dose groups. The study measures safety, tolerability and preliminary antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa IDP-023, una terapia con células NK, sola o combinada con rituximab, daratumumab, isatuximab o interleucina-2, en adultos con cánceres de la sangre avanzados, incluidos el linfoma no Hodgkin y el mieloma múltiple recidivantes o refractarios. El registro no indica la vía, la frecuencia ni la duración de la administración, pero describe grupos con una dosis única y grupos con varias dosis. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad antitumoral preliminar.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that has returned or did not respond, after at least 3 prior lines of therapy
Non-Hodgkin lymphoma that has returned or did not respond, after failing at least 2 lines of chemotherapy
Investigator-judged life expectancy greater than 12 weeks
not_for: Impaired cardiac function or clinically significant heart disease
HIV infection, active hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection
Untreated brain, central nervous system, or epidural tumor metastasis
